## Measurement provenance

Source base: a43e1577eaa4e9255d1d840ef5e38d55b37555b5 plus changes. Final runtime/benchmark-source hashes are identical across full/recheck campaigns. Tracked-diff hashes may differ because documentation was updated between campaigns; per-file code hashes identify measured implementation. Core arithmetic is unchanged from the base; Auto adds a policy and dispatch guards. No ROG sanitizer or Mac/ARM run is claimed.
